papers.title: Contact without protection: high antenatal attendance, minimal hepatitis B testing in Nigerias mother-to-child prevention cascade -- how far from elimination?
papers.translated_title: 无保护接触：尼日利亚母婴阻断 cascade 中产前检查率高、乙肝检测极少——距离消除还有多远？
papers.author: Abanni, S. I.
papers.summary: Hepatitis B is a leading preventable cause of liver cancer, and in high-burden settings most chronic infection is acquired around birth. Nigeria carries Africas largest hepatitis B burden. Preventing mother-to-child transmission requires a chain of antenatal steps: testing pregnant women, acting on the result, and vaccinating the newborn. No nationally representative study has assembled these into a single prevention cascade. We built the first national hepatitis B mother-to-child prevention cascade for Nigeria and measured how far it falls from the World Health Organizations triple-elimination targets. We analysed the 2023-24 Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey, the first Nigerian survey to carry both a maternal hepatitis B module and infant birth-dose records. Among 13,341 women with a most recent live birth in the preceding three years, each linked to that childs immunisation record, we estimated coverage at each cascade step (antenatal attendance, hepatitis B testing in antenatal care, result received, and the infant birth dose) using complex-survey methods, and examined patterning by wealth, education, residence, travel time, and region. Although 72% of mothers attended antenatal care, only 12.3% (95% CI 11.4-13.2) were tested for hepatitis B there, and among the few tested almost all received a result: the loss fell at testing, not at result-return. The infant birth dose reached 55.0% (53.1-56.9), 35 points below target, and ran at a level unrelated to maternal testing, consistent with universal, non-targeted delivery; place of delivery, not maternal testing, was the dominant correlate of an infant receiving it. Both steps were steeply patterned: antenatal testing ranged from 2.6% in the poorest wealth quintile to 32.4% in the richest, and was lowest in the North-West, the zone with Nigerias highest prevalence. Nigeria already reaches most mothers through antenatal care but rarely uses that contact to test for hepatitis B, and the universal birth dose is only half delivered. The country is far from elimination, and furthest where the virus is commonest. Integrating hepatitis B testing into antenatal care, made free and weighted toward the highest-burden north, would convert contact already achieved into protection.
papers.translated_summary: 乙型肝炎是肝癌最主要的可预防病因之一，在高负担地区，大多数慢性感染是在围产期获得的。尼日利亚承担着非洲最重的乙型肝炎负担。预防母婴传播需要一系列产前步骤：检测孕妇、根据结果采取行动、为新生儿接种疫苗。目前尚无全国代表性研究将这些步骤整合为一条单一的预防级联。我们构建了尼日利亚首个全国性乙型肝炎母婴预防级联，并测量了其与世界卫生组织三重消除目标的差距。我们分析了2023-24年尼日利亚人口与健康调查，这是尼日利亚首个同时包含孕产妇乙型肝炎模块和婴儿出生剂量记录的调查。在13,341名过去三年内最近一次活产的女性中，每人与其孩子的免疫接种记录相关联，我们使用复杂抽样方法估算了级联各步骤的覆盖率（产前保健就诊、产前保健中的乙型肝炎检测、收到结果以及婴儿出生剂量），并考察了其与财富、教育、居住地、出行时间和地区的分布模式。尽管72%的母亲接受了产前保健，但仅12.3%（95% CI 11.4-13.2）在那里接受了乙型肝炎检测，而在少数接受检测者中几乎所有人都收到了结果：损失发生在检测环节，而非结果反馈环节。婴儿出生剂量覆盖率为55.0%（53.1-56.9），低于目标35个百分点，且其水平与母亲是否接受检测无关，这与普遍、非靶向接种的做法一致；分娩地点而非母亲检测是婴儿获得出生剂量的主要相关因素。两个步骤均呈现明显的梯度分布：产前检测率从最贫困财富五分位数的2.6%到最富裕的32.4%不等，且在西北区最低，而该区是尼日利亚患病率最高的地区。尼日利亚已经通过产前保健覆盖了大多数母亲，但很少利用这一接触机会进行乙型肝炎检测，且普遍出生剂量仅完成一半。该国远未达到消除目标，且在病毒最流行的地区差距最大。将乙型肝炎检测整合入产前保健，使其免费并向高负担的北部倾斜，将把已经实现的接触转化为保护。

papers.title: DXA-derived body composition and blood pressure in underweight and overweight adolescent girls in rural and urban South Africa
papers.translated_title: 南非农村和城市地区体重不足和超重青少年女孩的DXA衍生身体成分与血压
papers.author: Crouch, S. H.
papers.summary: Background: Elevated blood pressure (BP) during adolescence is an early marker of cardiovascular risk, particularly in settings experiencing under and overnutrition. However, the relationship between detailed body composition and BP across nutritional extremes remains poorly understood. We examined associations between dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA)-derived body composition and BP among underweight and overweight South African adolescent girls to assess multilevel correlates of BP. Methods: The Ntshembo trial included 1268 girls 13-19-years from rural Agincourt and urban Soweto. Participants were selected as underweight or overweight. BP was measured in triplicate at a single visit and classified into clinic BP category ranges. DXA provided measures of fat mass (FM), fat-free soft tissue mass (FFSTM), and related indices. Results: Mean SBP and DBP were 110.0{+/-}11.2mmHg and 68.7{+/-}8.2mmHg, respectively; 21.1% of participants had elevated or hypertensive-range BP. Overweight adolescents had higher SBP and BP categories compared with underweight adolescents. DXA-derived adiposity measures were positively associated with SBP and BP category. FFSTM showed strong association with SBP. Higher FM/FFSTM was associated with elevated (RRR=4.25, 95%CI:1.77-10.20) and hypertensive-range BP (RRR=19.04, 95%CI:6.43?56.40). Caregiver hypertensive-range BP was independently associated with adolescent hypertensive-range BP (RRR=1.72-1.82). Sedentary behaviour independently associated with elevated BP, highlighting a modifiable behavioural target alongside intergenerational risk. Associations were more consistent for SBP than DBP. Conclusions: both FM and FFSTM positively associated with BP, particularly SBP. Regional percentage analyses were consistent with higher BP when a greater proportion of total fat was distributed centrally rather than peripherally.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：青少年期血压升高是心血管风险的早期标志，尤其是在同时经历营养不足和营养过剩的环境中。然而，在营养极端情况下，详细身体成分与血压之间的关系仍知之甚少。我们研究了南非体重不足和超重青春期女孩中，双能X线吸收法（DXA）衍生的身体成分与血压之间的关联，以评估血压的多层次相关因素。方法：Ntshembo试验纳入了1268名13-19岁女孩，分别来自农村Agincourt和城市Soweto。参与者被选为体重不足或超重。血压在单次访视中测量三次，并分类为临床血压类别范围。DXA提供了脂肪量（FM）、去脂软组织量（FFSTM）及相关指数的测量。结果：平均收缩压和舒张压分别为110.0{+/-}11.2mmHg和68.7{+/-}8.2mmHg；21.1%的参与者血压处于升高或高血压范围。与体重不足青少年相比，超重青少年的收缩压和血压类别更高。DXA衍生的肥胖指标与收缩压和血压类别呈正相关。FFSTM与收缩压显示强关联。较高的FM/FFSTM与血压升高（RRR=4.25，95%CI：1.77-10.20）和高血压范围血压（RRR=19.04，95%CI：6.43?56.40）相关。照护者高血压范围血压与青少年高血压范围血压独立相关（RRR=1.72-1.82）。久坐行为与血压升高独立相关，突出了一个可改变的行为目标以及代际风险。关联在收缩压方面比舒张压更为一致。结论：FM和FFSTM均与血压呈正相关，尤其是收缩压。区域百分比分析与以下情况一致：当总脂肪更多分布于中心而非外周时，血压更高。

papers.title: Association between blood urea nitrogen-to-albumin ratio and kidney stones: A cross-sectional study based on NHANES
papers.translated_title: 血尿素氮与白蛋白比值和肾结石之间的关联：基于NHANES的横断面研究
papers.author: Zhu, F.
papers.summary: Kidney stones are a disorder in which urinary solutes precipitate to form crystalline aggregates in the urinary space. The blood urea nitrogen-to-albumin ratio (BAR), a common inflammatory indicator, has an unclear association with kidney stones. Using NHANES 2007-2020 data, we compared baseline characteristics between kidney stone formers and controls and evaluated the BAR-stone relationship via weighted multivariate logistic regression (WMLR), restricted cubic splines (RCS), stratification analyses, and XGBoost, with validation in an independent external cohort. Twenty baseline features, including BAR and age, differed significantly between groups (P < 0.05). In all WMLR models, BAR was positively and nonlinearly associated with kidney stone risk (OR > 1, P < 0.05). Subgroup analyses revealed stable associations in females (OR = 1.10, P < 0.001), low vitamin A intake (OR = 1.10, P < 0.001), high water intake (OR = 1.11, P < 0.001), age < 50 years (OR = 1.14, P < 0.01), and education less than high school (OR = 1.11, P < 0.01). XGBoost identified BAR and water intake as prominent risk factors (AUC = 0.658). External validation confirmed a positive association (Model 1 OR = 1.029, 95% CI 1.016-1.043; Model 2 OR = 1.030, 95% CI 1.016-1.044; Model 3 OR = 1.029, 95% CI 1.015-1.045; all P < 0.001), and RCS confirmed a nonlinear dose-response relationship (nonlinear P = 0.0006). Subgroups aged [≥] 60 years, males, and females showed significant associations (ORs = 1.027-1.034). In XGBoost, BAR was the most important predictor (Gain = 0.265). These findings reveal a significant association between BAR and kidney stones, offering theoretical insights for prevention and risk stratification; BAR may serve as a valuable marker in kidney stone management.
papers.translated_summary: 肾结石是一种疾病，其中尿液中的溶质沉淀在泌尿空间中形成结晶聚集体。血尿素氮与白蛋白比值（BAR）作为一种常见的炎症指标，其与肾结石的关联尚不明确。利用NHANES 2007-2020数据，我们比较了肾结石患者与对照组的基线特征，并通过加权多因素logistic回归（WMLR）、限制性立方样条（RCS）、分层分析和XGBoost评估了BAR与结石的关系，并在一个独立外部队列中进行了验证。包括BAR和年龄在内的20个基线特征在两组间存在显著差异（P < 0.05）。在所有WMLR模型中，BAR与肾结石风险呈正向非线性关联（OR > 1，P < 0.05）。亚组分析显示，在女性（OR = 1.10，P < 0.001）、低维生素A摄入（OR = 1.10，P < 0.001）、高饮水量（OR = 1.11，P < 0.001）、年龄< 50岁（OR = 1.14，P < 0.01）以及受教育程度低于高中（OR = 1.11，P < 0.01）的人群中关联稳定。XGBoost识别出BAR和饮水量为突出的危险因素（AUC = 0.658）。外部验证证实了正向关联（模型1 OR = 1.029，95% CI 1.016-1.043；模型2 OR = 1.030，95% CI 1.016-1.044；模型3 OR = 1.029，95% CI 1.015-1.045；均P < 0.001），RCS证实了非线性剂量-反应关系（非线性P = 0.0006）。年龄[≥] 60岁、男性和女性亚组均显示出显著关联（ORs = 1.027-1.034）。在XGBoost中，BAR是最重要的预测因子（Gain = 0.265）。这些发现揭示了BAR与肾结石之间的显著关联，为预防和风险分层提供了理论见解；BAR可能作为肾结石管理中的一个有价值标志物。

papers.title: Hepatitis E virus immunoglobulin G seropositivity and kidney dysfunction among United States adults
papers.translated_title: 美国成年人中戊型肝炎病毒免疫球蛋白G血清阳性与肾功能障碍
papers.author: Abu Saadeh, A.
papers.summary: Background Hepatitis E virus infection is associated with renal manifestations in selected clinical populations. Whether serologic evidence of previous exposure is associated with kidney dysfunction in the general population remains uncertain. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional analysis of six National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey cycles from 2009-2018 and August 2021-August 2023. Adults aged [≥]20 years with valid hepatitis E virus immunoglobulin G levels, serum creatinine levels, urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratios, and covariate data were included. The outcomes included a reduced estimated glomerular filtration rate (<60 mL/min/1.73 m2), albuminuria (albumin-to-creatinine ratio [≥]30 mg/g [3.39 mg/mmol]), and their composite. Survey-weighted logistic regression models were unadjusted, adjusted for age and sex, and additionally adjusted for demographic and clinical covariates. Results Among 30,428 adults, 2,911 were seropositive; the weighted seroprevalence was 8.29%. The seropositive participants were older than the seronegative participants were (weighted mean, 60.7 versus 46.5 years). Seropositivity was associated with all three binary outcomes in unadjusted analyses, but the estimates approached the null after adjustment for age and sex. The fully adjusted odds ratios were 0.99 (95% confidence interval, 0.85-1.16) for a reduced filtration rate, 1.05 (0.91-1.22) for albuminuria, and 1.05 (0.93-1.19) for composite kidney dysfunction. In a secondary analysis, seropositivity was associated with a 1.57 mL/min/1.73 m2 higher adjusted mean filtration rate (95% confidence interval, 0.71-2.43). Conclusions Hepatitis E virus immunoglobulin G seropositivity was not significantly associated with binary kidney outcomes after adjustment. Attenuation occurred principally after adjustment for age and sex. These findings do not establish the absence of an association and do not address kidney injury during active or persistent infection.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 戊型肝炎病毒感染在特定临床人群中与肾脏表现相关。既往暴露的血清学证据是否与普通人群的肾功能障碍相关仍不确定。方法 我们对2009-2018年以及2021年8月至2023年8月的六个美国国家健康与营养调查周期进行了横断面分析。纳入年龄[≥]20岁、具有有效戊型肝炎病毒免疫球蛋白G水平、血清肌酐水平、尿白蛋白与肌酐比值以及协变量数据的成年人。结局包括估算肾小球滤过率降低（<60 mL/min/1.73 m2）、白蛋白尿（白蛋白与肌酐比值[≥]30 mg/g [3.39 mg/mmol]）及其复合结局。调查加权logistic回归模型包括未调整模型、调整年龄和性别的模型，以及进一步调整人口学和临床协变量的模型。结果 在30,428名成年人中，2,911名为血清阳性；加权血清阳性率为8.29%。血清阳性参与者比血清阴性参与者年龄更大（加权均值，60.7岁对46.5岁）。在未调整分析中，血清阳性与所有三项二分类结局均相关，但在调整年龄和性别后，估计值接近无效值。完全调整后的比值比分别为：滤过率降低0.99（95%置信区间，0.85-1.16），白蛋白尿1.05（0.91-1.22），复合肾功能障碍1.05（0.93-1.19）。在一项二次分析中，血清阳性与调整后平均滤过率高出1.57 mL/min/1.73 m2相关（95%置信区间，0.71-2.43）。结论 调整后，戊型肝炎病毒免疫球蛋白G血清阳性与二分类肾脏结局无显著相关。衰减主要发生在调整年龄和性别之后。这些发现并不能确定不存在关联，也未涉及活动性或持续性感染期间的肾损伤。

papers.title: Dietary Intake During Breast Cancer Treatment and Its Association with Changes in Cardiometabolic Risk Markers and Psychological Outcomes in Women with Breast Cancer: A Prospective Cohort Study Protocol
papers.translated_title: 乳腺癌治疗期间的膳食摄入及其与乳腺癌女性心脏代谢风险标志物变化和心理结局的关联：一项前瞻性队列研究方案
papers.author: Asbaghi, O.
papers.summary: Background: Active systemic therapy, including chemotherapy alone or combined with HER2-directed targeted therapy, is a cornerstone of breast cancer management, yet it frequently precipitates adverse cardiometabolic, anthropometric, and psychological disturbances. Although dietary intake during active treatment may modulate these complications, rigorous prospective cohort evidence utilizing repeated dietary assessments and standardized clinical endpoints remains limited. Objective: The primary objective of this prospective cohort study is to investigate the longitudinal association between dietary intake during active cancer treatment and changes in the visceral adiposity index (VAI), serving as the primary cardiometabolic endpoint, among women with breast cancer. Secondary objectives are to examine associations between dietary exposures and individual cardiometabolic markers, body composition, psychological distress, and health-related quality of life. Methods: A prospective cohort of 100 women with histologically confirmed primary breast cancer is recruited at the initiation of systemic therapy and followed prospectively for six months in Tehran, Iran. The cohort encompasses patients undergoing standard chemotherapy regimens (spanning 4.5 to 6 months), including those receiving sequential HER2-directed targeted therapy. Habitual dietary intake during active treatment is assessed using nine 24-hour dietary records systematically distributed across the early, middle, and late treatment phases (incorporating weekdays and weekend days). Clinical, anthropometric, biochemical, and psychological outcomes are evaluated at baseline (pre-treatment) and at the 6-month follow-up. Primary multivariable linear regression models will specify the 6-month VAI as the dependent variable, adjusting for its baseline level, age, baseline body mass index, tumor stage, active treatment regimen, follow-up physical activity, and total energy intake. Secondary analyses will evaluate key secondary cardiometabolic parameters, psychological outcomes, and exploratory end-of-study serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D concentrations. Regression results will be reported as unstandardized coefficients (B) with 95% confidence intervals and standardized coefficients ({beta}). Conclusion: This prospective protocol outlines a standardized methodology to determine whether dietary intake during active systemic therapy tracks with adverse cardiometabolic trajectories and psychological burden, generating crucial evidence to inform tailored nutritional interventions during active breast cancer treatment.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：全身积极治疗，包括单纯化疗或联合HER2靶向治疗，是乳腺癌管理的基石，但常引发不良的心血管代谢、人体测量学和心理紊乱。尽管积极治疗期间的膳食摄入可能调节这些并发症，但利用重复膳食评估和标准化临床终点的严格前瞻性队列证据仍然有限。目的：本前瞻性队列研究的主要目的是探讨乳腺癌女性在积极癌症治疗期间的膳食摄入与内脏脂肪指数（VAI）变化之间的纵向关联，VAI作为主要心血管代谢终点。次要目的是检查膳食暴露与个体心血管代谢标志物、身体成分、心理困扰和健康相关生活质量之间的关联。方法：在伊朗德黑兰招募100名经组织学确诊为原发性乳腺癌的女性组成前瞻性队列，在全身治疗开始时入组，并前瞻性随访六个月。该队列涵盖接受标准化疗方案（持续4.5至6个月）的患者，包括接受序贯HER2靶向治疗的患者。积极治疗期间的 habitual 膳食摄入通过九份24小时膳食记录进行评估，这些记录系统地分布在治疗早期、中期和晚期阶段（包括工作日和周末）。临床、人体测量学、生化和心理结局在基线（治疗前）和6个月随访时进行评估。主要多变量线性回归模型将6个月时的VAI指定为因变量，并调整其基线水平、年龄、基线体重指数、肿瘤分期、积极治疗方案、随访期体力活动和总能量摄入。次要分析将评估关键次要心血管代谢参数、心理结局和探索性研究结束时血清25-羟基维生素D浓度。回归结果将报告为未标准化系数（B）及95%置信区间和标准化系数（{beta}）。结论：本前瞻性方案概述了一种标准化方法，以确定积极全身治疗期间的膳食摄入是否与不良心血管代谢轨迹和心理负担相关，从而为积极乳腺癌治疗期间量身定制的营养干预提供关键证据。

papers.title: Shared and unique chromatin accessibility and 3D functional interactions of substance use disorder loci implicate cell types beyond the brain
papers.translated_title: 物质使用障碍位点的共享和独特染色质可及性及三维功能相互作用暗示了大脑以外的细胞类型
papers.author: Trang, K. B.
papers.summary: Objective: Recent genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have revealed multiple loci for substance use disorders (SUDs), including evidence that the traits overlap in genetic etiology. However, the extent of underlying SUD causal variants, effector genes, and cellular contexts, remains unclear. Recent clinical trials of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists have shown promising effects on alcohol and tobacco consumption, raising the question of whether SUD genetic risk resides in metabolic as well as neural cell types. We sought to map the cell-type-specific genetic architecture of four SUDs and to test whether the observed metabolic enrichment reflects shared causal biology with type 2 diabetes (T2D). Methods: We integrated our 3D genomic datasets (high-resolution promoter-focused Capture-C/Hi-C, ATAC-seq, RNA-seq) from 59 diverse human cell types with recent GWAS summary statistics for alcohol (AUD), tobacco (TUD), opioid (OUD), and cannabis use disorder (CanUD), using Stratified LD regression (S-LDSC). We performed local genetic correlation analysis (LAVA) between SUDs and T2D, multivariate integration (DIABLO) of gene expression and chromatin accessibility at shared loci, and subsequent bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) to test for causal relationships between T2D and each SUD. Results: After per-trait false discovery rate (FDR) correction, TUD showed significant heritability enrichment in pancreatic {beta}-cells (4.6-fold), -cells (4.0-fold), hypothalamic neurons, and iPSC-derived neurons. CanUD showed FDR-significant enrichment concentrated in hypothalamic neural progenitor cells (7.4-fold). LAVA identified 1,550 loci with significant local genetic correlations, 114 specifically between T2D and at least one SUD. Subsequent MR revealed that genetic liability for T2D was protective against AUD (inverse-variance weighted {beta} = -0.027, P-values = 1.6x10-5, 463 instruments), consistent across four of five MR methods and free of directional pleiotropy. Cell-cell interaction modeling implicated distinct neuro-endocrine signaling axes disrupted by each SUD.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：近期全基因组关联研究（GWAS）已揭示物质使用障碍（SUDs）的多个位点，包括有证据表明这些性状在遗传病因学上存在重叠。然而，潜在的SUD因果变异、效应基因和细胞背景的范围仍不清楚。近期胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂的临床试验已显示出对酒精和烟草消费的有希望效果，这引发了SUD遗传风险是否存在于代谢细胞类型以及神经细胞类型中的问题。我们试图绘制四种SUD的细胞类型特异性遗传结构，并检验观察到的代谢富集是否反映了与2型糖尿病（T2D）共享的因果生物学。方法：我们将来自59种多样化人类细胞类型的3D基因组数据集（高分辨率启动子聚焦Capture-C/Hi-C、ATAC-seq、RNA-seq）与近期针对酒精（AUD）、烟草（TUD）、阿片类（OUD）和大麻使用障碍（CanUD）的GWAS汇总统计量整合，使用分层LD回归（S-LDSC）。我们进行了SUD与T2D之间的局部遗传相关分析（LAVA），对共享位点处的基因表达和染色质可及性进行了多变量整合（DIABLO），并随后进行双向两样本孟德尔随机化（MR），以检验T2D与每种SUD之间的因果关系。结果：在按性状进行错误发现率（FDR）校正后，TUD在胰腺{beta}细胞（4.6倍）、-细胞（4.0倍）、下丘脑神经元和iPSC衍生神经元中显示出显著的遗传力富集。CanUD显示出FDR显著的富集，集中在下丘脑神经祖细胞中（7.4倍）。LAVA识别出1,550个具有显著局部遗传相关的位点，其中114个特异性地位于T2D与至少一种SUD之间。随后的MR揭示，T2D的遗传易感性对AUD具有保护作用（逆方差加权{beta} = -0.027，P值 = 1.6x10-5，463个工具变量），在五种MR方法中的四种中一致，并且不存在方向性多效性。细胞-细胞相互作用建模表明，每种SUD扰乱了不同的神经-内分泌信号轴。

papers.title: Exploring the role of social networks in shaping STI disclosure among adolescents and young people using a health behavioral model in Lusaka, Zambia.
papers.translated_title: 探索社交网络在赞比亚卢萨卡青少年和年轻人中影响性传播感染披露的作用，运用健康行为模型。
papers.author: Witola, G.
papers.summary: Disclosure of sexually transmitted infections (STIs) is a key strategy for STI prevention and control. However, for adolescents and young people (AYP) aged 15-24, disclosure remains a challenge, usually shaped by several dynamics that affect AYP's choice of whether to disclose or not, and to whom. This study sought to understand what influenced AYP decisions to disclose their STI status and to whom, using the Capability, Opportunity, and Motivation-Behaviour (COM-B) model, in Lusaka, Zambia. This qualitative study, conducted from April-August 2024, included twenty in-depth interviews with AYP who participated in a cross-sectional STI prevalence survey, including those diagnosed with an STI, self-reporting STI symptoms, and reported ever being treated (regardless of symptoms). Additionally, five focus group discussions (FGDs) with AYP and another six FGDs with community members were conducted. Data were then analysed thematically using the COM-B model. The capability to disclose was influenced by AYP's limited knowledge about STIs. Physical opportunity to disclose was shaped by the availability and accessibility of youth-friendly Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH) services, while community and self-stigma, and relationships and household dynamics also shaped AYP's social opportunities to disclose their STI status. Motivation to disclose was influenced by concern for one's overall health, individual values and beliefs, and the need to seek support when experiencing an STI. However, fear of negative reactions reduced AYP's motivation and willingness to disclose their STI status. AYP's decisions to disclose an STI diagnosis is shaped by a network of personal and social influences. Social support plays an important role in disclosure, with supportive social networks facilitating the process and thus encouraging individuals to seek treatment. STI interventions should not only focus on individuals but also on increasing STI awareness, reducing stigma, and leveraging existing social support within the broader community context.
papers.translated_summary: 披露性传播感染（STIs）是性传播感染预防和控制的一项关键策略。然而，对于15-24岁的青少年和年轻人（AYP）而言，披露仍然是一项挑战，通常受到多种动态因素的影响，这些因素塑造了AYP是否披露以及向谁披露的选择。本研究旨在利用能力、机会和动机-行为（COM-B）模型，在赞比亚卢萨卡了解哪些因素影响了AYP披露其性传播感染状况以及向谁披露的决定。这项定性研究于2024年4月至8月开展，包括对参与横断面性传播感染患病率调查的AYP进行的二十次深度访谈，其中包括被诊断患有性传播感染者、自我报告性传播感染症状者，以及报告曾经接受过治疗者（无论是否有症状）。此外，还开展了五次与AYP的焦点小组讨论（FGDs），以及另外六次与社区成员的焦点小组讨论。随后使用COM-B模型对数据进行了主题分析。披露的能力受到AYP对性传播感染知识有限的影響。披露的物理机会受到青年友好型性与生殖健康（SRH）服务的可获得性和可及性的影响，而社区和自我污名，以及人际关系和家庭动态也影响了AYP披露其性传播感染状况的社会机会。披露的动机受到对自身整体健康的关切、个人价值观和信念，以及在感染性传播感染时寻求支持的需要的影响。然而，对负面反应的恐惧降低了AYP披露其性传播感染状况的动机和意愿。AYP披露性传播感染诊断的决定受到个人和社会影响网络的塑造。社会支持在披露中发挥着重要作用，支持性的社会网络促进了这一过程，从而鼓励个人寻求治疗。性传播感染干预措施不仅应关注个人，还应致力于提高性传播感染意识、减少污名，并利用更广泛社区背景中现有的社会支持。

papers.title: Liwen Ablation versus Modified Morrow Myectomy for Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: 1-Year Hemodynamic and Conduction Outcomes
papers.translated_title: 室间隔心肌消融术与改良Morrow心肌切除术治疗梗阻性肥厚型心肌病：1年血流动力学与传导结局
papers.author: Jiao, J.
papers.summary: Background: In obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, surgical myectomy is highly effective but carries a recognized risk of postoperative conduction disturbances. Percutaneous intramyocardial septal radiofrequency ablation (Liwen procedure) is a less invasive alternative, but head-to-head comparisons of longitudinal hemodynamic trajectories and conduction system safety remain scarce, limiting evidence-based treatment selection. Methods: This single-center retrospective cohort included 211 patients treated 2018?2023 (124 Liwen, 87 modified Morrow myectomy). The primary longitudinal analysis included 133 patients with 1-year follow-up and serial data (75 Liwen, 58 modified Morrow myectomy). Repeated outcomes were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models and generalized estimating equations, adjusted for baseline covariates. Results: Both procedures reduced LVOT gradient, but trajectories differed (interaction P=0.002). At 1 year, the covariate-adjusted mean LVOT gradient remained higher after Liwen than after myectomy (16.1 vs 1.3 mmHg, P<0.001). However, the adjusted 1-year predicted probability of new conduction abnormalities was markedly lower after Liwen (5% vs 62%, P<0.001), with no permanent pacemaker implantations in the Liwen group. Most patients achieved gradient <30 mmHg in both groups (82% vs 96%; nominal P=0.308). Liwen had shorter procedure duration (80 vs 185 min) and hospital stay (11 vs 16 days). Serious adverse event rates were similar (8.1% vs 9.2%) but profiles differed. Conclusions: Modified Morrow myectomy achieved more complete LVOT gradient reduction at 1 year, whereas Liwen ablation had fewer conduction abnormalities, shorter procedure duration, and shorter hospital stay. These findings highlight a clinically relevant trade-off between more complete hemodynamic relief and lower conduction-system injury and require prospective confirmation.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：在梗阻性肥厚型心肌病中，外科心肌切除术高度有效，但存在公认的术后传导障碍风险。经皮心肌内室间隔射频消融术（Liwen 手术）是一种创伤更小的替代方案，但关于纵向血流动力学轨迹和传导系统安全性的头对头比较仍然很少，限制了循证治疗选择。方法：这项单中心回顾性队列纳入 2018 年至 2023 年接受治疗的 211 例患者（124 例 Liwen，87 例改良 Morrow 心肌切除术）。主要纵向分析纳入 133 例具有 1 年随访和连续数据的患者（75 例 Liwen，58 例改良 Morrow 心肌切除术）。重复结局采用线性混合效应模型和广义估计方程进行分析，并针对基线协变量进行调整。结果：两种手术均降低了 LVOT 压差，但轨迹不同（交互作用 P=0.002）。1 年时，协变量调整后的平均 LVOT 压差在 Liwen 术后仍高于心肌切除术后（16.1 对 1.3 mmHg，P<0.001）。然而，调整后 1 年新发传导异常预测概率在 Liwen 术后明显更低（5% 对 62%，P<0.001），Liwen 组无永久起搏器植入。两组中大多数患者均达到压差 <30 mmHg（82% 对 96%；名义 P=0.308）。Liwen 的手术时间更短（80 对 185 分钟），住院时间更短（11 对 16 天）。严重不良事件发生率相似（8.1% 对 9.2%），但事件特征不同。结论：改良 Morrow 心肌切除术在 1 年时实现了更完全的 LVOT 压差降低，而 Liwen 消融术的传导异常更少、手术时间更短、住院时间更短。这些发现突出了更完全的血流动力学缓解与更低的传导系统损伤之间具有临床相关性的权衡，需要前瞻性研究确认。

papers.title: Association of Helicobacter Pylori Infection and Dyslipidemia Among Individuals Attending General Health Checkups at Tribhuvan University Teaching Hospital.
papers.translated_title: 特里布万大学教学医院普通健康检查人群中幽门螺杆菌感染与血脂异常的相关性。
papers.author: Man Shrestha, T.
papers.summary: Background Helicobacter pylori is a highly prevalent chronic infection that induces persistent gastric inflammation and has been increasingly implicated in alterations of lipid metabolism. Several studies suggest an association between H. pylori infection and dyslipidemia, potentially contributing to atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease; however, findings remain inconsistent and causal relationships are debated. Objective The objective of the study is to determine the association between Helicobacter pylori infection and dyslipidemia. Materials and methods This study is a cross-sectional study conducted at Tribhuvan University Teaching Hospital (TUTH), Kathmandu, Nepal, a tertiary care referral center. It involved a retrospective analysis of records collected at General Health Checkup (GHC) clinic by a physician. Data collection was done retrospectively from pre-existing medical records. The study population included patients with documented H. pylori serological status and available lipid profile results during the study period. Information on demographic characteristics, clinical presentation, medication use, lifestyle factors and known comorbidities was collected using a pretested, standardized questionnaire adapted from literature. Standardized methods were used for anthropometric measurements. Body mass index (BMI) was calculated as weight (kg) divided by height squared (m2). Results This study included a total of 242 participants and categorized them into three groups based on Helicobacter pylori serology - seronegative, equivocal, and seropositive. In the study, BMI and body weight showed significant positive correlations with LDL (r = 0.208, p = 0.008) and total cholesterol (r = 0.187, p = 0.017). Body weight was positively correlated with total cholesterol (r = 0.204, p = 0.009). No significant correlations were observed between fasting blood glucose and lipid parameters, suggesting that H. pylori infection may be associated with increased body weight, though not with overt hyperglycemia. The current study's findings showed that there was no statistically significant difference in the mean Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS) levels of those with and without H. pylori infection. (FBG: 5.37 {+/-} 1.20 mmol/L in seronegative participants, 5.29 {+/-} 0.93 mmol/L in equivocal participants, and 5.56 {+/-} 0.92 mmol/L in seropositive participants (p = 0.347)). Among other risk factors, a significant association was found between male sex and H. pylori infection (H. pylori-seropositive men (49.1%) compared to seronegative males (26.5%), p = 0.004). Smoking status did not substantially differ among patients who tested positive for H. Pylori, and alcohol consumption showed a weak correlation (P=0.064). Conclusion The findings of the study suggest that H. pylori seropositivity is significantly associated with higher body weight and dyslipidemia, particularly elevated TC and LDL cholesterol levels, highlighting the importance of lipid screening and weight reduction in H. pylori-positive patients.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 幽门螺杆菌是一种高度流行的慢性感染，可诱导持续性胃部炎症，并日益被认为与脂质代谢改变有关。多项研究表明幽门螺杆菌感染与血脂异常之间存在关联，可能促进动脉粥样硬化和心血管疾病；然而，研究结果仍不一致，因果关系存在争议。目的 本研究旨在确定幽门螺杆菌感染与血脂异常之间的关联。材料与方法 本研究是一项在尼泊尔加德满都特里布万大学教学医院（TUTH）进行的横断面研究，该医院为三级转诊中心。研究对医生在一般健康检查（GHC）门诊收集的记录进行了回顾性分析。数据从已有的医疗记录中回顾性收集。研究人群包括在研究期间有记录的幽门螺杆菌血清学状态且有可用血脂谱结果的患者。使用根据文献改编的预测试标准化问卷收集人口学特征、临床表现、用药情况、生活方式因素和已知合并症的信息。人体测量采用标准化方法。体重指数（BMI）按体重（kg）除以身高（m2）的平方计算。结果 本研究共纳入242名参与者，并根据幽门螺杆菌血清学将其分为三组——血清阴性、不确定和血清阳性。在研究中，BMI和体重与LDL（r = 0.208，p = 0.008）和总胆固醇（r = 0.187，p = 0.017）呈显著正相关。体重与总胆固醇呈正相关（r = 0.204，p = 0.009）。空腹血糖与脂质参数之间未观察到显著相关性，提示幽门螺杆菌感染可能与体重增加有关，但与明显的高血糖无关。本研究结果显示，有和无幽门螺杆菌感染者的平均空腹血糖（FBS）水平无统计学显著差异。（FBG：血清阴性参与者为5.37 {+/-} 1.20 mmol/L，不确定参与者为5.29 {+/-} 0.93 mmol/L，血清阳性参与者为5.56 {+/-} 0.92 mmol/L（p = 0.347））。在其他危险因素中，发现男性与幽门螺杆菌感染之间存在显著关联（幽门螺杆菌血清阳性男性（49.1%）与血清阴性男性（26.5%）相比，p = 0.004）。幽门螺杆菌检测阳性患者的吸烟状况无显著差异，饮酒显示出弱相关性（P=0.064）。结论 研究结果表明，幽门螺杆菌血清阳性与较高的体重和血脂异常显著相关，尤其是总胆固醇和LDL胆固醇水平升高，突出了对幽门螺杆菌阳性患者进行血脂筛查和减重的重要性。

papers.title: No evidence of increased gaming-related problems with long-term use of a video game therapeutic: Exploratory endpoint findings from a randomized controlled trial
papers.translated_title: 长期使用一款电子游戏疗法未发现游戏相关问题增加的证据：一项随机对照试验的探索性终点发现
papers.author: Lukka, L.
papers.summary: Digital therapeutics for mental health often face low patient engagement, which limits their clinical impact. Interventions that deliver treatment using a video game medium may improve engagement and therapeutic efficacy, but the potential emergence of gaming-related problems remains a safety question and a concern among clinical stakeholders. We examined whether long-term adjunctive use of the video game therapeutic Meliora was associated with changes in gaming-related problems in a three-arm randomized controlled trial. Participants were adults with interview-confirmed major depressive disorder without significant gaming or gambling problems at baseline. The intention-to-treat cohort (n = 1,001) had a mean age of 33.4 years (SD 9.3), and 64% were female. From baseline to post-intervention (week 12), Game Addiction Scale (GAS-7) scores decreased in the Meliora group (mean change, -0.63 points; 95% CI, -0.91 to -0.34; dz = -0.24; Holm-adjusted p < 0.001), whereas no change was observed in the Sham group, which used a highly similar video game therapeutic (mean change, -0.02 points; 95% CI, -0.25 to 0.28; dz = -0.01; Holm-adjusted p = 0.900). Between-group analyses showed more negative GAS-7 change in the Meliora group than in the Sham group (adjusted mean difference, -0.19 points; 95% CI, -0.30 to -0.08; d = -0.13; Holm-adjusted p = 0.001), indicating a relatively greater reduction with Meliora, whereas changes were similar between the Meliora and TAU groups (adjusted mean difference = 0.04 points; 95% CI, -0.08 to 0.15; d = 0.03; Holm-adjusted p = 0.509). Intervention usage time, experienced immersion, and their interaction were not significantly associated with changes in GAS-7 scores in either the Meliora or Sham group. Using a [≥]25% deterioration threshold, deterioration occurred in 10.4% of participants in the Meliora group, 15.3% in the Sham group, and 9.8% in the TAU group, with no statistically significant between-group differences. Complementary per-protocol analyses among participants with greater intervention exposure were consistent with the ITT findings. These findings provide no evidence that long-term use of a video game therapeutic was associated with increased gaming-related problems in appropriately screened patients using interventions with safeguards against excessive use.
papers.translated_summary: 用于心理健康的数字疗法常面临患者参与度低的问题，这限制了其临床效果。使用电子游戏媒介提供治疗的干预措施可能提高参与度和治疗效果，但游戏相关问题的潜在出现仍是一个安全性问题，也是临床利益相关者关注的问题。我们在一项三臂随机对照试验中考察了长期辅助使用电子游戏疗法Meliora是否与游戏相关问题的变化有关。参与者为经访谈确认患有重性抑郁障碍、基线时无明显游戏或赌博问题的成年人。意向治疗队列（n = 1,001）的平均年龄为33.4岁（SD 9.3），64%为女性。从基线到干预后（第12周），Meliora组的游戏成瘾量表（GAS-7）评分下降（平均变化，-0.63分；95% CI，-0.91至-0.34；dz = -0.24；Holm校正p < 0.001），而使用高度相似电子游戏疗法的Sham组未观察到变化（平均变化，-0.02分；95% CI，-0.25至0.28；dz = -0.01；Holm校正p = 0.900）。组间分析显示，Meliora组的GAS-7变化比Sham组更负（校正平均差，-0.19分；95% CI，-0.30至-0.08；d = -0.13；Holm校正p = 0.001），表明Meliora组的下降相对更大，而Meliora组与TAU组之间的变化相似（校正平均差 = 0.04分；95% CI，-0.08至0.15；d = 0.03；Holm校正p = 0.509）。干预使用时间、体验到的沉浸感及其交互作用与Meliora组或Sham组中GAS-7评分的变化均无显著关联。使用[≥]25%恶化阈值时，Meliora组10.4%的参与者出现恶化，Sham组为15.3%，TAU组为9.8%，组间差异无统计学显著性。在干预暴露更多的参与者中进行的补充符合方案分析结果与ITT结果一致。这些发现未提供证据表明，在适当筛选的患者中，使用具有防止过度使用保障措施的干预时，长期使用电子游戏疗法与游戏相关问题增加有关。
